summary: Backend testing for 'The Punishers' engine modules - all 4 engines fully functional. Lawsuit Architect, Integrity Database, Immutable Vault, and Political Strike endpoints all working correctly.
passed_tests: Lawsuit Architect: POST /api/lawsuit-architect/generate returns markdown + pdf_base64
Lawsuit Architect: GET /api/lawsuit-architect/complaints lists complaints
Lawsuit Architect: GET /api/lawsuit-architect/complaints/{id} returns single complaint
Lawsuit Architect: DELETE /api/lawsuit-architect/complaints/{id} removes complaint
Integrity DB: POST /api/integrity-db/profiles creates caseworker profile
Integrity DB: POST /api/integrity-db/profiles/{id}/violations logs violation
Integrity DB: GET /api/integrity-db/profiles/{id}/risk-metrics returns risk assessment
Integrity DB: GET /api/integrity-db/profiles lists profiles
Integrity DB: GET /api/integrity-db/search searches profiles
Integrity DB: PUT /api/integrity-db/violations/{id}/verify marks violation verified
Integrity DB: DELETE /api/integrity-db/profiles/{id} removes profile
Immutable Vault: POST /api/vault/generate-key generates AES-256 key (32 bytes)
Immutable Vault: POST /api/vault/seal encrypts evidence with AES-256-GCM
Immutable Vault: GET /api/vault/certificates lists certificates
Immutable Vault: GET /api/vault/certificates/{id} returns single certificate
Immutable Vault: POST /api/vault/verify verifies certificate integrity
Political Strike: GET /api/political-strike/contacts fetches contacts
Political Strike: GET /api/political-strike/contacts?state=TX filters by state
Political Strike: POST /api/political-strike/generate-dossier creates dossier
Political Strike: GET /api/political-strike/dossiers lists dossiers
Political Strike: GET /api/political-strike/dossiers/{id} returns single dossier
Political Strike: POST /api/political-strike/dispatch sends simulated dispatch
Political Strike: GET /api/political-strike/dispatch-reports/{id} returns dispatch report
All 4 engine endpoints require authentication (401/403 without token)

notes: Generates 42 U.S.C. §1983 complaint in markdown format
Stores plaintiff, defendant, agency, incident, violations, bond details, children info
Creates caseworker profiles with badge, agency, region, supervisor
Logs violations with type, date, description, evidence hash
Risk metrics calculation: total_violations, constitutional_violations, strike_rate, risk_level
Search by name, badge, agency working
GPS coordinates capture (latitude, longitude, altitude, accuracy)
Dossier generation with violations, vault refs, FOIA/1983 status
Dispatch simulation with SIMULATED status for all targets

critical_code_review_comments: All 4 engine modules properly implement authentication via get_current_user dependency
MongoDB _id excluded from all responses using projection {'_id': 0}
Proper error handling with HTTPException for 404 cases
AES-256-GCM encryption correctly implemented with nonce and AAD
PDF generation uses reportlab with proper page handling
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up during tests (TEST_ prefixed)
